title: Give Pills
text:
/cultivation givepill <player> <family> <id> <purity> <quantity> [affinity]


Families: healing, qi, cultivation, food. Tab suggests matching pill IDs and names.


Purity: 0-100; quantity: 1-1024; stacks hold 16. Optional affinity selects a cultivation pill element (default Wood).


Given pills remain unidentified.
